banners.text: Freeze season is coming. Book your sprinkler blowout now. New J&M installs get their first blowout free.
Planning a new lawn or sprinkler system for spring? Get on our schedule early.
Spring is here. Book your sprinkler start-up before the rush.
Brown spots or high water bills? We'll find the problem.

services.name: Sprinkler Repair
services.summary: Dry spots, leaks, broken heads or a zone that won't shut off. We find the real cause and fix it once. $75 diagnostic, waived when we do the repair.
services.photo_alt: Rotating sprinkler watering a green lawn

services.name: Sprinkler System Installation
services.summary: A new system zoned for your yard's sun, shade and slopes. Free estimate, 1-year warranty, and your first blowout free.
services.photo_alt: Close-up of a sprinkler head spraying a lawn in the sun

services.name: Sprinkler Blowouts
services.summary: We clear every zone with compressed air before the first hard freeze, so your pipes and backflow make it through winter.
services.photo_alt: Frost on blades of grass on a winter morning

services.name: Spring Start-Ups
services.summary: We turn the water back on slowly, run every zone, adjust heads and fix what winter broke.
services.photo_alt: Sprinkler spraying sparkling water over a sunny lawn

services.name: Sod Installation
services.summary: Fresh sod on properly graded soil, with your sprinklers set for new-lawn watering from day one.
services.photo_alt: Worker rolling out fresh sod over prepared soil

reviews.name: Maria G.
reviews.text: Our back zone was dry all summer and two other companies just swapped heads. Juan found a crushed pipe under the patio, fixed it in one visit and tested every zone before leaving.

reviews.name: Derek T.
reviews.text: New build with bare dirt. J&M put in the sprinkler system and the sod in two days, gave us a clear price up front and cleaned up everything.

reviews.name: Rosa M.
reviews.text: The blowout was quick and they showed me where my backflow shutoff is. It took a few days to get on the October schedule, so book early.
